product_metadata.title: Roomie Tec Cordless Stick Vacuum Cleaner with Stand-Alone Battery, HEPA Filter for Pet Hair, 2 in 1 Handheld Dust Buster with Powerful Suction, Low Reach Design & LED Headlights
features: EXTREME LOW ANGLE CLEANING – This cordless stick vacuum has a full flat floor brush that can get deep under almost any furniture. You can unfold the handle to lower it closer to the ground without you squatting.
LONG RUN TIME – With 2 power settings, the ECO mode has approximately 35 minutes of run time, while the Max mode can run for about 15 minutes.
INTERCHANGEABLE – Stand-alone rechargeable battery packs are also available, so you may keep a spare for extensive use or to easily replace a dead one.
6 LED HEADLIGHTS - Provide excellent lighting under furniture. ONE-CLICK DISPOSAL - Keep your hands clean when emptying the dust bin.
WHAT YOU'LL GET - Roomie "Elite" Cordless Stick Vacuum, Battery Pack, AC Power Adaptor, Multi-function Crevice Tool, Wall-Mount Accessories, and our User Manual.
